name: Setup Linux
description: Set up Linux workspace on EC2 or OSDC ARC runners

use-arc.description: Whether the runner is an OSDC ARC runner (returned by runner_determinator)

python-version.description: Python version to install (e.g. "3.12"). Empty string keeps the default.

compiler.description: Compiler name and version (e.g. "gcc11", "clang15"). Empty string keeps the base image default.

cuda-version.description: CUDA version to activate (e.g. "13.0"). Empty string keeps the default.

submodules.description: Submodule checkout mode passed to checkout-pytorch (default "recursive", use "false" for test jobs).

checkout-mode.description: Checkout mode passed to checkout-pytorch (one of "normal", "blobless", "treeless").

github-token.description: GITHUB_TOKEN, needed to retrieve the workflow job id.
